description: Open the Dendro visualizer webview in VS Code. Call this ONCE before visualize_batch or visualize_analysis (they can also auto-open by passing an entryFile param). The response reports the parsed tree size — a 1-2 node tree means the entry file is likely a wrapper/layout; pick a higher-fan-out entry instead.

entryFile.description: Absolute path to the entry React component file (e.g., /path/to/App.tsx)

name: open_visualizer
